data.body: Filtered-register checkpoint. The externally reviewed draft has been adjudicated into 49 scoped work packages. The register separates confirmed defects from research, separates authored-source changes from generated outputs, preserves protected artifacts, and coordinates CLI discovery with existing work. An automated scan found no prohibited dash, spaced hyphen, semicolon, colon, contraction, or banned diction in the draft. The internal records survey remains pending. Project files remain unchanged.
